case: custom enum[] SQL-file replay preserves a backslash label across PostgreSQL string-setting modes
contract: The enum[] contains literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, comma, quote, markup, a backslash-bearing label and SQL NULL.
The same generated SQL file is replayed in transactions under all four standard_conforming_strings/backslash_quote combinations: on/safe_encoding, on/off, off/off and off/on.
Each replay is compared with native array text, array_to_json elements and array_send bytes.
An existing sibling enum[] row remains byte-identical and exactly one imported row is added in each mode; the transaction is rolled back after verification.
remaining: Other enum consumers/configurations and the broader B3 type/engine matrix remain open; this case does not qualify 0.2.0.
